endings.name: The One Who Stayed
endings.summary: He sat on the elders' bench at the Recognition, kept his blue a while longer, heard his brothers go through the wall, and dims the lamps for the next group.

endings.name: Taken by the River
endings.summary: An immune beast took one brother before the heart. The rest arrive with an empty place on the raft and are separated as written; the taken one is turned aside into his own vessel.

endings.name: Two Together
endings.summary: Two brothers who rowed in time all river long squeezed on the song's last note and were swept into one chamber. Everyone else is lost to them.

endings.name: Carried Away
endings.summary: The current splits in the heart and every brother is swept a different way, holding the tool another carved for him. "No one stays together."
